archetypes.name: sidecar-ordering
archetypes.rationale: Pre-launch sidecar ordering is the highest-risk contract change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the waterfall invalid-slot skip path with special attention to ordering. Confirm sidecar write failures happen before any reviewer launch and that no paths file is written on those failure paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step3-propagation
archetypes.rationale: The warning crosses Python and Bash envelope boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace DEGRADED_PANEL_WARNING from panel dispatch through round values, plan_review envelope persistence, design_lifecycle allowlists, and the Step 3 wrapper stdout replay. Look for paths that drop or duplicate the warning. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: mixed-manifest
archetypes.rationale: The manifest remains mixed on disk by design.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review manifest readers after invalid slot rows are skipped. Confirm non-dict and malformed rows are ignored where intended without rewriting the original manifest or masking fail-closed behavior for other callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
